messages:
sam: Heads-up — planning a config-only rollout for routing + batching + timeouts to prod tonight during the 19:00 PT change window. Targeting low-risk path:

sam: config tag is config-v3.4-routing-batch. No model changes. Only limits/timeouts/routing weights.

deploy-bot: scheduled deployment 1812349876 -> env=prod, type=config-only, tag=config-v3.4-routing-batch, change-window=19:00-19:40 PT, author=sam

maria: thanks. Canary plan? happy to watch dashboards.

sam: 5% canary for 15m, then 25% for 10m, then 100% if green. Rollback if p95 latency increases > 120ms over baseline or error rate > 0.5%. Also pin fallback to config-v3.3 immediately on rollback.

jen: add a soft cap on batching concurrency — we had KV pressure with last tweak. Proposed snippet:

```json
{"batching": {"max_concurrency": 64, "max_batch_tokens": 2048}, "routing": {"weight_default": 0.8, "weight_safe": 0.2}, "timeouts": {"request_ms": 60000, "generation_ms": 45000}}
```

sam: that looks good. We'll set the shaper to 64 and keep the prefetch at 2. Also enabling prefix KV cache TTL 30s.

david: on-call: I'll be watching infra and latency dashboards. Ping me if anomalies or if canary doesn't reach steady state by 19:30 PT.

maria: I'll watch QA metrics and quality diffs for a selected prompt set (promptset=prod-smoke-001). If we see regressions > 3% on hallucination or truncation, we rollback.

sam: yep. Observability checklist: token-level cost, p50/p95/p99, error spikes, retried requests, redis/KV eviction rate. Dashboards: /d/prod-routing, /d/prod-batching, /d/prod-llm-evals.

deploy-bot: canary started at 19:00 PT (5% traffic) — monitor: /d/prod-routing, /d/prod-batching

david: seeing slight p95 bump (+40ms) but under threshold, no errors. continuing. :thumbsup:

maria: QA diffs show no quality regressions so far.

deploy-bot: canary expanded to 25% at 19:15 PT

david: sustained p95 ok, error rate flat, KV eviction normal.

sam: proceeding to full rollout in 5. final checks from @maria @david @jen?

jen: approve.

maria: good from QE.

david: good from infra.

deploy-bot: rollout complete at 19:28 PT — tag=config-v3.4-routing-batch applied to prod.

sam: summary: rolled config-v3.4, canary 5/25/100, thresholds not breached. Pin note: we intentionally did NOT change model variant pins. If any tenant sees problems, we can pin that tenant to config-v3.3 and open an incident.

maria: leaving a short follow-up ticket to run overnight regression check.

david: thanks everyone. Closing the loop. :white_check_mark:
